annotationWithheld.clue: Go outside with a chap for an unknown quantity of cold soup

clue.text: Three articles on clever chap were highly distasteful

definitions.note: the answer is a noun for something loathed, used predicatively as in 'it was anathema to them'

parts.note: an indefinite article: an
the other indefinite article: a
the definite article: the
an MA, a Master of Arts, is a learned graduate

explanation.surface: Someone recalls three pieces of writing about a brainy man that offended everyone.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'on' means placed above, so the three articles come before MA.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that is anathema to a person is utterly detested by them, so 'highly distasteful' describes it in the predicative sense.

clue.text: Do stop advising me how to adjust my footwear!

definitions.text: Do stop advising me how to adjust my footwear!

parts.words: Do stop advising me how to adjust my footwear!
parts.note: a slang plea to be quiet, read literally as an instruction to put a garment for the foot into place

explanation.surface: An exasperated person tells a fussing friend to stop giving advice about their shoes and socks.
explanation.walkthrough: The British slang phrase for 'be quiet!' is read as if it were literal advice about hosiery.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom is a rude British way of telling someone to shut up, which fits a request to stop advising.

clue.text: Against being a soldier

definitions.meaning: a Latin-derived word meaning opposed to or versus
a Nicaraguan rebel fighter of the 1980s opposing the Sandinista government

explanation.definitionFit: The word means opposite or versus, and was also the name for US-backed Nicaraguan guerrilla fighters.

clue.text: There must be no twitch when dealing with ears

definitions.note: a phrase standing in for an adjective meaning relating to the ear

parts.note: O looks like zero, nothing
a tic is an involuntary twitch

explanation.surface: A doctor insists a patient must stop twitching during an ear examination.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means relating to the ear, the auditory organ, as in otic drops.

clue.text: He's getting older but is still in charge

parts.note: he is a man
ageing, here spelt aging

explanation.surface: An elderly boss is ageing but still running the show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'He's getting older' reads as one description of an elderly man; 'but is still' only links it to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone managing is running things, the person with authority over an operation.

clue.text: African flower that is blue and white

definitions.meaning: a flower is something that flows, a river, here one in Africa
the river's two great tributaries are the Blue and the White

explanation.definitionFit: The great African river is formed where the Blue and the White tributaries meet at Khartoum.

clue.text: China which was broken by a very young chick

definitions.text: China which was broken by a very young chick

parts.words: China which was broken by a very young chick
parts.note: a delicate porcelain type named after the brittle casing a hatchling pecks through

explanation.surface: Someone's fine porcelain was smashed by a baby bird.
explanation.walkthrough: 'China' suggests crockery smashed in an accident, but the very fine porcelain shares its name with what the hatching chick breaks.
explanation.definitionFit: Very thin, delicate porcelain is named for its likeness to the shell a hatching chick breaks out of.

clue.text: Trying to find the tin open er for fish which needs cooking

definitions.text: Trying to find the tin open er for fish which needs cooking

parts.words: Trying to find the tin open er for fish which needs cooking
parts.note: searching through a drawer for a can opener is read as dragging a net for fish

explanation.surface: Someone hunts through the kitchen drawer for the can opener to get at some fish for dinner.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue is printed with 'open er' split; it means opener. Rummaging through things in search of something is also fishing with a dragged net.
explanation.definitionFit: Searching thoroughly through a mass of things and fishing with a dragged net are both described by this word.

clue.text: Haul a trolley

definitions.meaning: to carry or drag a load
a small wheeled vehicle, as in a supermarket

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a verb for transporting with effort and a noun for a wheeled vehicle pushed or pulled.

clue.text: Manchester graduate demolished accommodation for lobbies

indicators.note: something demolished is knocked down and rebuilt here as new letters

parts.note: BA, a Bachelor of Arts, is a graduate

explanation.surface: A Manchester university graduate's housing has been knocked down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'demolished' rearranges MANCHESTER plus BA; 'accommodation for' joins the wordplay to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Lobbies are waiting rooms or halls leading into larger rooms, which is what the plural word names.

clue.text: A blow here could lead to disqualification

definitions.text: A blow here could lead to disqualification

parts.words: A blow here could lead to disqualification
parts.note: blowing into a roadside alcohol-testing device can end with a driving ban

explanation.surface: A boxer's foul punch might get them thrown out of the fight.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a foul punch in boxing; the blow is a breath into a police device, and failing means losing one's driving licence.
explanation.definitionFit: Motorists blow into this police device to measure alcohol, and a high reading can mean a driving ban.

clue.text: Set off for school in time

indicators.note: the word school is placed inside the word time here

parts.note: a date is a point in time
Eton is the famous English public school

explanation.surface: A pupil leaves home in good time for school.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Set off' looks like setting out on a journey, but it means to explode.
explanation.definitionFit: To set off a bomb is to make it explode.

clue.text: American soldier in the rear of the crew

indicators.note: in a down clue to rear is to raise up, so the letters are read bottom to top
the soldier is placed inside the word the

parts.note: taken as written
a GI is a US private soldier

explanation.surface: A US soldier rows at the back of a boat's team.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts the soldier inside THE to give THGIE, and in a down clue 'rear' (raise) turns that upwards; 'rear' looks like the back of the boat.
explanation.definitionFit: A rowing crew of eight oarsmen is itself called an eight.

clue.text: Imagine that some are offside at every match

indicators.note: only some of the letters of these words are wanted, a run inside them

explanation.surface: A football fan claims some players are offside at every game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'some' points to the run of letters spanning 'offside at every'.
explanation.definitionFit: To ideate is to form an idea, to conceive in the mind.

clue.text: Large bag of white wine

definitions.meaning: a big coarse bag for carrying goods
an old name for dry white fortified wine from Spain

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a big bag of sturdy cloth and the old name for sherry-like Spanish white wine.

clue.text: Large number made their mark beyond boundary

definitions.meaning: a hundred and twenty, an old count by twenties
in cricket, batters who hit the ball over the boundary scored six runs

explanation.definitionFit: Six score is 120, and in cricket a hit clearing the boundary scores a six.

clue.text: First man very keen to become king

indicators.note: the first letter of the word man is the one wanted

parts.note: agog means eagerly excited

explanation.surface: The first man is desperate to be crowned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'First man' suggests Adam, but it is only the first letter of 'man'.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Bible Gog is ruler of the land of that name, and in British legend the giant is named as a ruler.

clue.text: Mother's after a small car-one of the smallest

definitions.note: the definition is singular but the answer is plural

indicators.note: the mother piece is placed after the car piece

parts.note: the Mini is a famous small British car
mum is mother; the 's gives the S

explanation.surface: Mum is following someone in a tiny car that is one of the smallest on the road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after' sets the mother piece behind the car; the definition is singular in the clue but the answer is plural.
explanation.definitionFit: Minimums are least possible amounts, the very smallest figures.

clue.text: Stories which are untrue may be long

explanation.definitionFit: A tall story is an unbelievable tale, and a tall person is long in the body.

clue.text: Being taught how to make money in fish

indicators.note: the money-making word goes inside the word for fish

parts.note: the ling is a long sea fish of the cod family
to earn is to make money

explanation.surface: A fisherman learns how to profit from the catch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'how to' is a link; 'in' puts the money-making word inside the fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Learning is acquiring knowledge, the state of a pupil being instructed.

clue.text: Statue erected soon after ten zero result

indicators.note: the word for soon comes after the ten and the zero

parts.note: X is ten in Roman numerals
O looks like zero
anon is an old word for soon

explanation.surface: A statue goes up shortly after a ten-nil win.
explanation.walkthrough: A xoanon is a primitive carved wooden image of a god in ancient Greece; 'erected' and 'result' complete the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a primitive wooden image of a deity in ancient Greece, a carved figure.

clue.text: Like a drum many tap inaccurately at fifty

indicators.note: tapped inaccurately, so these letters come out in the wrong order

parts.note: L is fifty in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Many people tap clumsily at fifty beats.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inaccurately' rearranges the two words into TYMPANA, and 'at' joins the fifty.
explanation.definitionFit: Tympanal means relating to a tympanum, the drum or eardrum.

clue.text: Cut the grass around the last three dead in the field

indicators.note: the mowing word wraps round the letters taken from dead

parts.note: to mow is to cut grass

indicators.note: only the final three letters of the word dead are used

explanation.surface: Someone mows round the dead in a churchyard field.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the last three' of 'dead' are EAD, which 'around' wraps in the mowing word; 'field' is the definition, not the cricket sense.
explanation.definitionFit: A meadow is a grassy field, often cut for hay.

clue.text: At the same time, not in favour of things which aren't permanent

definitions.note: a phrase standing in for an adjective meaning existing in the same period

parts.note: con means against, as in pros and cons
temporary describes what does not last

explanation.surface: Someone simultaneously opposes anything that won't last.
explanation.walkthrough: 'things which aren't permanent' reads as a noun phrase but stands for the adjective TEMPORARY.
explanation.definitionFit: Contemporary means existing or occurring in the same period, simultaneous.

clue.text: Signals agreement then falls asleep

definitions.meaning: moves the head up and down to say yes

explanation.definitionFit: Someone bobbing their head agrees, and someone dozing off lets their head drop.

clue.text: Not even linked with ends

definitions.meaning: the phrase 'and ends' completes the idiom for bits and pieces

explanation.definitionFit: Odd numbers are the uneven ones, and the idiom for miscellaneous remnants pairs this word with ends.

clue.text: Upsets over the method of cooking

indicators.note: turned over, so the word upsets is read backwards

parts.note: tips means upsets, overturns

explanation.surface: Someone overturns the cooking method.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' turns TIPS round.
explanation.definitionFit: Roasting on a revolving rod over a fire is a way to cook meat.

clue.text: Grass took in judge and was set free

indicators.note: the grass word swallows the judging word, holding it inside

parts.note: a reed is a tall grass
to deem is to judge or consider

explanation.surface: A grass informant took in a judge and was released.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Grass' suggests a police informer, but it is the plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Redeemed means freed or rescued, as a captive bought out of bondage.

clue.text: Waste of time after the prophet took direction

indicators.note: the time word comes after the prophet piece
the prophet word holds the compass point inside it

parts.note: a seer is a prophet
W is the compass direction west
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: Time wasted after a prophet changed course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'took' puts W inside the prophet for SEWER, and 'after' puts the time behind it; 'of' links.
explanation.definitionFit: Sewerage is the system carrying away human waste and drainage.
